cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Let Go of the Grudge
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender resentment, distance, or a claim that keeps the relationship stuck.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll handle the fragile things for your move. Missing your birthday doesn't have to keep me out of every box.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I needed you then. You didn't show.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're right. Pick one box, then, and tell me how you want it carried. I'll start there and stay until the job's done.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The birthday glasses. Still wrapped, because nobody came.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Glasses first, then. I'll keep them beside me in the car; you can check every one when we arrive. Could we unwrap two together? I'll do all the washing up. I don't want you still drinking alone because I missed that night.

reason: Sustain a capable moving lead who yields task choice and inspection, then uses the birthday glasses to ask B to relax the exclusion.
